Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: Claude Haiku 5.5 ¥11.00 vs Qwen3.5-Plus ¥16.32 on a common CNY basis (list prices $1.64 / ¥16.32) — at this fixed usage, Claude Haiku 5.5 is cheaper by ¥5.32/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, Qwen3.5-Plus costs about 1.5× Claude Haiku 5.5 (Claude Haiku 5.5 is ~33% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $0.1 vs ¥0.8; after conversion Claude Haiku 5.5 is lower (by ≈ ¥0.13/1M tokens).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $0.5 vs ¥4.8; after conversion Claude Haiku 5.5 is lower (by ≈ ¥1.44/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): Claude Haiku 5.5 $0.01; Qwen3.5-Plus publishes no cache price (estimated at the standard input price).
  • Currencies: Claude Haiku 5.5 is billed in USD, Qwen3.5-Plus in CNY; conversion uses the CFETS central parity rate (see above) and is indicative only.
  • Context window: Claude Haiku 5.5 1024K vs Qwen3.5-Plus 1000K — Claude Haiku 5.5 is 1.0× Qwen3.5-Plus.
  • Modalities: Claude Haiku 5.5=Text, Image understanding; Qwen3.5-Plus=Text (Claude Haiku 5.5 adds Image understanding).
  • Price sources: Anthropic official pricing (verified 2026-10-28), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio pricing (verified 2026-09-18); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (Claude Haiku 5.5 in USD, Qwen3.5-Plus in CNY; cross-currency figures converted to CNY as noted above).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
